headline: ByteDance Founder Tops China Wealth List Driven by Artificial Intelligence Push
summary: ByteDance founder Zhang Yiming reclaimed his position as China's wealthiest individual following strong growth tied to the company's expansion into artificial intelligence applications.
why: ByteDance is one of the world's most valuable privately owned technology companies, operating global platforms such as TikTok and Douyin.

impacts.name: ByteDance
impacts.why: Commercial adoption of internal AI features drives corporate revenue expansion and valuation.
